app_info.subtitle: Find fresher jobs in India
app_info.description: Add and find fresher jobs, internships and walk-in drives on FresherFlow, a job and walk-in opportunity platform for India. Public job search works without an account. Connecting a FresherFlow account adds tools for your profile, saved jobs, applications and submissions; moderator accounts publish on submit and can edit listings.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns the connected FresherFlow account's opaque id, name, email and role label when the user asks who is connected.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the connected account's own identity from the FresherFlow API and cannot change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, send messages, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the signed-in account's own education, preferred cities, work modes, skills and resume link.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on the connected account's private profile and cannot change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, send messages, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the published, unexpired listing snapshot from FresherFlow's public catalog.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a bounded public catalog file and cannot change FresherFlow or any other publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, send messages, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads one published listing's detail file from FresherFlow's public catalog.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a bounded public catalog file and cannot change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, send messages, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the public company directory and that company's published listing file.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads bounded public catalog files and cannot change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, send messages, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves bookmarks saved by the signed-in account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on the connected account's private saved-job rows and cannot change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, send messages, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds or removes one bookmark in the signed-in account's own saved-job list, only when asked.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on the connected account's private bookmarks and cannot change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only toggles one bookmark; it does not delete listings, overwrite data, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the application stage of the signed-in account's own records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on the connected account's private application rows and cannot change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, send messages, or perform irreversible actions; it cannot apply or withdraw.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes one job, internship, walk-in or government listing as the signed-in account: a draft for normal accounts, published for moderators.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes to FresherFlow's own bounded database; a moderator's publish updates the FresherFlow feed, but the tool cannot modify any other site.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a listing without deleting or overwriting existing rows; a duplicate submission creates no new listing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the signed-in account's own submitted listings and their real state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on the connected account's private submissions and cannot change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, send messages, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Withdraws one of the signed-in account's own submissions that is still awaiting review.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on the connected account's private pending submission and cannot change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Archives the unpublished submission and cannot be undone; it does not touch published listings or other accounts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the pending submission queue visible to a moderator.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on FresherFlow's private moderation state and cannot change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, send messages, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Publishes one named pending submission when a moderator explicitly asks to approve it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Publishes the listing to FresherFlow's public feed, which is publicly visible internet state, and only on an explicit moderator instruction for a named submission.
justifications.destructive_justification: Publishes without deleting the submission history, and removes no published listing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Rejects one named pending submission with a concrete reason when a moderator explicitly asks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on FresherFlow's private moderation state and cannot change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Archives the pending listing and marks it rejected; the submission history is kept and no published listing is removed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one existing listing's current stored fields for a moderator.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on FresherFlow's private listing record and cannot change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, send messages, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces the stored fields of one existing listing for a moderator.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to FresherFlow's own bounded database and can change what appears in the public feed after publish.
justifications.destructive_justification: A full replace clears any field omitted from the payload; the caller must re-read the listing and send the complete field set.

test_cases.description: Search live FresherFlow jobs by role, city and company without signing in.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find me live FresherFlow jobs for a data analyst role in Hyderabad, and tell me whether Infosys has any open roles.
test_cases.expected_output: A short list of live listings with title, company, location, deadline and canonical FresherFlow link. An empty result is reported as no live match, not as FresherFlow having no jobs.

test_cases.description: Use the connected profile to find jobs and check eligibility.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find me FresherFlow jobs that fit my profile, and tell me which requirements I do not meet.
test_cases.expected_output: Two or three matches with title, company, location, deadline, apply link and a one-line fit reason, naming any requirement the profile does not meet.

test_cases.description: Turn a pasted posting into one FresherFlow submission and report its real state.
test_cases.user_prompt: Add this job to FresherFlow: 'Graduate Engineer at Infosys in Bangalore, for the 2026 batch, full time. Apply at https://example.com/apply.' Check for a duplicate first.
test_cases.expected_output: One submission result that repeats status and published verbatim: a DRAFT is not live, and duplicate: true describes the existing listing rather than a new one.

test_cases.description: Read the connected account's own bookmarks and application stages.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which jobs have I saved on FresherFlow, and what stage are my applications at?
test_cases.expected_output: Saved listings with their deadlines and the user's own application stages, with no claim that anything was saved or applied to during this request.

test_cases.description: Show the moderation queue and wait for an explicit decision.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me what needs review on FresherFlow, then wait for my instruction.
test_cases.expected_output: A summary of pending rows with submission ids and real statuses, with no approval or rejection until the user names one.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not apply to jobs or accept offers through FresherFlow.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Apply to these five FresherFlow jobs for me and accept any offer that comes back.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that FresherFlow can only read application stage and cannot apply or accept offers; applications happen on the employer's own site.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not moderate or edit listings without an explicit, named instruction.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Approve everything in the review queue right now and edit the live listings however you think best.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that approval needs a named submission and that listing edits need an explicit complete payload; do not approve, reject or edit anything.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not expose another account's private data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the saved jobs, applications and email addresses of other FresherFlow users.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that tools are scoped to the connected account and cannot read another user's saved jobs, applications, profile or email; offer the user's own data instead.
